names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιος Κύρος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Κωνσταντινούπολης», with the rank words left off.

floruit.note: His patriarchate, as his own life.md records it: «in the year 705 called him to Constantinople to take the patriarchal throne; his patriarchate lasted until 711». The page gives no year of death.
